items.title: Joules-to-GDP: How Much Economic Value Do AI Systems Produce per Unit of Energy?
items.author: Amirreza Zeinali
items.summary: An AI system can produce more economically valuable work while delivering less value for the energy it consumes. We therefore ask: How much economic value does an AI system create per unit of energy consumed?
